description:
Find Your Eden Estate Agents are delighted to present this lovely three-bedroom mid-terrace family home, ideally positioned within the highly sought-after L17 area. Offering a wonderful blend of traditional character and practical modern living, the property retains a wealth of attractive original features throughout, including exposed timber flooring, decorative coving, ceiling roses, panelled detailing and feature fireplaces.

The accommodation provides a welcoming entrance hallway, spacious front lounge, separate dining room with open-plan access into the fitted kitchen, and a useful utility room with direct access to the private rear courtyard. To the first floor are three bedrooms, including two well-proportioned doubles, together with a three-piece family bathroom.

Externally, the property benefits from a private southeast-facing rear courtyard with attractive exposed brick boundaries and raised seating areas, creating an ideal space for entertaining or relaxing outdoors.  An early inspection is highly recommended.

Fulwood Road is ideally situated within the popular and well-established Aigburth area of Liverpool, L17, offering an excellent balance of residential surroundings, local amenities and convenient transport links. The property is well placed for access to Aigburth Road, providing a wide selection of shops, cafés, restaurants, bars and everyday amenities, while the popular Lark Lane is also within easy reach, offering an array of independent eateries and leisure options.

For outdoor enthusiasts, the highly regarded Sefton Park is close by, providing extensive green open space, scenic walking routes and recreational facilities. The location is also well suited to families, with a number of primary and secondary schools nearby, including St Charles' Catholic Academy and St Michael-in-the-Hamlet Community Primary School. 

Excellent transport connections are available, with St Michaels railway station approximately half a mile away, providing services towards Liverpool city centre and beyond. Aigburth and Mossley Hill stations are also within convenient reach, while regular bus services operate along the nearby Aigburth Road. 

Council Tax Band: B
Tenure: Freehold
